name: Website leads to Google Sheets with Telegram alert and auto-reply (Italian)
description: Captures website form leads via webhook, appends them to Google Sheets, alerts the owner on Telegram and sends a courtesy reply to the lead. Docs in Italian.

setup: "Nuovo lead dal sito" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value sheetName: Sheet tab name (for example Sheet1). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Google Sheets spreadsheet id (from the sheet URL) (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value chatId: Chat Id. Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /nuovo-lead). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## ⚙️ CONFIGURAZIONE (5 min)

1. **Webhook**: copia l'URL di produzione del nodo 'Nuovo lead dal sito' e usalo come destinazione del form del tuo sito (WordPress: plugin WPForms/Elementor → webhook; oppure azione POST custom).
   Il form deve inviare i campi: `nome`, `email`, `telefono`, `messaggio`.
2. **Google Sheets**: collega le credenziali Google e indica il tuo foglio 'Registro Lead' con le colonne: Data | Nome | Email | Telefono | Messaggio | Stato.
3. **Telegram**: crea un bot con @BotFather, incolla il token nelle credenziali e inserisci il tuo Chat ID.
4. **Gmail**: collega l'account che invierà l'email di cortesia al cliente.

Poi ATTIVA il workflow (interruttore in alto a destra).
